podcast.body: This song is featured on Radiohead's "In Rainbows" album. The album was notable for its groundbreaking "tip jar" release strategy in 2007, allowing fans to pay what they wished for the digital download. "Radio head with body snatchers from the In Rainbows album."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song is featured on Radiohead's *In Rainbows* album, which is notable for its groundbreaking independent release and "tip jar" pricing model. "Let's go back to In Rainbows. This is Body Snatchers."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This track from Radiohead's "In Rainbows" album was recorded directly off the studio floor. This recording approach means the song is essentially a live performance captured in the studio, giving it a raw and immediate quality. "That recording was made right off the floor in the studio, so it's pretty much a live recording."
